items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: this evangelist Baptist church, as Reverend Spears, that's the corner of Felicity and Willow. As a child, every Sunday we went to Bible class and to 11 o'clock service.

ctx.x: But when you were a kid, did the family march you off on Sunday to church?

Oh, we all had to go to church. And I was like, you know, this evangelist Baptist church, as Reverend Spears, that's the corner of Felicity and Willow. As a child, every Sunday we went to Bible class and to 11 o'clock service. But it wasn't something where you had to do. It wasn't admitted, you know, like if you don't go, this is going to happen. Mom, it was all in a little space, you know. But you couldn't do nothing wrong. I'm honored for that. She was on top of the case, you know. But it wasn't a thing where…
No regrets. So was your mother an influence on your life? Very much so, yeah. It seems that.
